title: Strategy Extractor (v1 - Corrected): Extracting Agent-Level Summary Metrics from Raw Transgenerational Logs
abstract: This corrected submission re-executes `strategy_extractor_v1.py` with the `--in` argument properly specified, pointing to the consolidated raw transgenerational logs (`all_transgen_logs.jsonl`). It extracts agent-level summary metrics (agent_id, total_reward, most_specialized_action, specialization_index) from the `execution_log` field of each generation. The extracted data will be output as `agent_strategy_summary.jsonl`, providing a foundational dataset for tracking strategy evolution and novelty across generations, resolving the previous argument parsing error.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import os
import json

# Define file paths and directories
STRATEGY_EXTRACTOR_SCRIPT = "storage/progressor/strategy_extractor_v1.py" # The script I just defined
INPUT_RAW_CONSOLIDATED_FILE = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl" # Output from Eval ID 1079
OUTPUT_AGENT_STRATEGY_SUMMARY_FILE = "storage/progressor/agent_strategy_summary.jsonl" 

# --- Execute Strategy Extractor Script ---
print("--- Executing Strategy Extractor Script ---")
command_extract_strategies = [
    "python", STRATEGY_EXTRACTOR_SCRIPT,
    "--in", INPUT_RAW_CONSOLIDATED_FILE,
    "--out", OUTPUT_AGENT_STRATEGY_SUMMARY_FILE,
    "--debug" # Keep debug to see verbose output
]

print(f"Executing strategy extraction command: {' '.join(command_extract_strategies)}")
try:
    result_extract = subprocess.run(command_extract_strategies, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, shell=False)
    print("STDOUT (Strategy Extraction):")
    print(result_extract.stdout)
    if result_extract.stderr:
        print("STDERR (Strategy Extraction):")
        print(result_extract.stderr)
    print("Strategy extraction script executed successfully.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error during strategy extraction script execution: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    exit(1)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Python or the script {STRATEGY_EXTRACTOR_SCRIPT} was not found.")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during strategy extraction: {e}")
    exit(1)

print("\nAll agent strategy summary extraction steps successfully completed. The dataset is now ready for novelty analysis!")
